snippet.title: NOMAD // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/2408640/NOMAD/

Weave and slide under waves of projectile hazards in this energetic movement shooter. Dispatch hordes of lost and otherworldly foes as you avenge the planet's demise. Creatively utilize flexible movement mechanics to navigate the environment for fluid movement and displacing enemies.

Developed by 
Gregg Rahuba
